*Nīvaraṇagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.8) is an Abhidhamma treatise forming part of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text analyzes the conditional relations of phenomena classified under the *nīvaraṇa-gocchaka* (the cluster of hindrances) in conjunction with the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined dhammas) [SuttaCentral].
